SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c2.id AS child_id, c2.name AS child_name, c2.parent_id AS child_parent_id FROM pms_category c LEFT JOIN pms_category c2 ON c2.parent_id = c.id AND c2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.parent_id = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.id, c2.id
